citations.claim: controller force exceeds fmax at first violating step

counterfactual.change: set controller noise from 0.219 to 0.0, keeping all other fields identical; this keeps commanded force within fmax

explanation: Shrunk scenario has 1 step, dt~0.021, kp~28.6, vcmd~4.4, fmax~81.18, noise~0.22. Controller computes force from velocity error plus seeded sensor noise without clamping/noise accounting. With noise, commanded force is 105.53 exceeding fmax 81.18 at step 1. Setting noise to 0 reduces force below fmax (verified by counterfactual), confirming noise injection is not included in fmax limiting.
vision_note: Between step 0 and step 1 the red (controller-driven) body shows almost no visible displacement, remaining near the top center above the green waypoint. No wall collision, tunneling, or erratic motion is apparent in the two frames.
